serviceIdentification.serviceName: Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Platform for Government
serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Platform for Government
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Chargie designs, installs and operates an Electronic Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure system and management platform providing seamless management of charging stations and sessions.  Chargie platforms require no integration with agency networks, systems or data.  The Chargie platform ensures agency EV fleet and facilities managers the ability to maintain management and visibility of EV charging stations, sessions and reporting via a web-based portal in addition to a seamless charging experience for drivers with the Chargie mobile device app or RFID tag.
